items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1960-10-27
items.q: I studied across the river from a fellow named Professor Monetta.

ctx.x: I used to fool around with it but I never did play it. I studied across the river from a fellow named Professor Monetta. Oh, I see. I know you, know his pupils. He taught quite a few things. They play in the brass band.
Where did the other fellows used to follow us? Your buddy went to Chicago. Did he ever come back?
